title: MARS Technical Report
abstract: arXiv:2611.24006v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern industrial recommender systems use multi-stage cascades--retrieval, pre-ranking, ranking, and re-ranking--to narrow millions of candidates to a personalized list. While each stage deploys sophisticated models, pipeline-level decisions on channel activation, quotas, model selection, and score fusion remain engineer-tuned and user-agnostic within each scenario.   This report presents MARS (Multi-stage Agentic Recommendation System), extending personalization from individual-stage predictions to full pipeline orchestration. A near-line agent built on fine-tuned Qwen3-0.6B generates per-user configurations--a seven-dimensional action covering pipeline mode, retrieval quotas, model selection, fusion weights, and reranker settings--from a constrained action space. Configurations are validated, cached, and consumed asynchronously; the cascade never waits for LLM inference. Schema checks, fallbacks, and a kill switch ensure serving safety

translated_abstract: 现代工业推荐系统采用多阶段级联架构——召回、粗排、精排和重排——将数百万候选缩小为个性化列表。尽管每个阶段都部署了复杂的模型，但在每个场景内，流水线级别的决策（如通道激活、配额、模型选择和分数融合）仍依赖工程师调优，且不针对用户个性化。本报告提出MARS（多阶段智能体推荐系统），将个性化从单阶段预测扩展到整个流水线的编排。基于微调的Qwen3-0.6B构建的近线智能体，从受限的动作空间中为每个用户生成配置——一个涵盖流水线模式、召回配额、模型选择、融合权重和重排器设置的七维动作。配置经过验证、缓存并异步消费，级联流程从不等待LLM推理。模式校验、回退机制和终止开关共同确保了服务的安全性。
tldr: MARS提出了一种基于微调Qwen3-0.6B的多阶段智能体推荐系统，通过近线智能体为每个用户动态生成七维流水线配置（涵盖召回配额、模型选择、融合权重等），将个性化从单阶段预测扩展到整条推荐流水线的编排，并以异步缓存机制确保级联流程不被LLM推理阻塞。
en_tdlr: MARS extends personalization from individual-stage predictions to full pipeline orchestration by using a fine-tuned Qwen3-0.6B near-line agent to asynchronously generate per-user seven-dimensional pipeline configurations, ensuring the recommendation cascade never waits for LLM inference.
